name: Olga Ivanova

resumeText: Olga Ivanova is a Machine Learning Engineer at Lumina Analytics with five years of experience, starting as a backend engineer at Nortek Software before moving into ML. She owns the full model lifecycle for PyTorch and TensorFlow models, packaging them with Docker, orchestrating on Kubernetes, and tracking experiments and models in MLflow. She works closely with data engineers to keep feature pipelines fresh and is focused on reliable, reproducible model serving.
